listing.name: Persona 2: Innocent Sin (PSP) — p2recomp (hinamihere)
listing.summary: The project reports a native title screen, field exploration and scripted Zodiac progression. Separate developer procedures can crash while warping. The project does not claim the full game works. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own European ULES01557 PSP game.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Generate and build locally from your own disc using the project’s MinGW, CMake, Ninja and Python instructions.
